notes.title: 🎉 OFFICE LIFE JUST GOT HOTTER! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44721122/a5cad057643a065131cfc6fe7b3c768582467bba.png[/img]

Big announcement incoming! 🚨

[h1]We’re thrilled to reveal our brand-new game — [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934490  ]Penicl Pushers: Sexy Office[/url] 🖊️🔥[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934490  

Welcome to Penicl Pushers Inc., where nobody knows what the company actually does…
but everyone knows exactly how to heat things up behind closed doors. 😏

Here, a strict boss-shapeshifter rules with an iron fist (and claws), your clumsy coworker spills coffee on her massive chest more often than she writes reports, a cold gyaru pierces you with icy stares, and a tomboy — plus an entire army of stunning office beauties — already has plans for you…

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44721122/59024f1903df0b92aa426197c89a2fdc3a2dda4f.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44721122/968f79d936e4ffe33ae5b0a1064ded57f3d6f945.png[/img]

[h1]Game Features:[/h1]

🧩 Addictive Merge2 puzzles
💋 A steamy office story packed with humor and passion
🎙️ Fully voiced and animated sex scenes
✌️ Choose your style: human or furry characters
📈 Relationship system with character development
💃 A whole office full of women for every taste

[h1]👉 Add to your wishlist and start the hottest career climb of your life![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934490

notes.title: Devlog 2.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/bc05f6ce6e589db24baed00f028924ae0e3fb2a3.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Greetings, Humans![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642840/Humans_are_not_that_against_Lizardwomen_2/
[h3][b]We bring good news for our friends abroad and fans of foreign languages😏[/b][/h3]

So that every brave warrior and fair maiden - even from distant lands - can understand our Part 2 DEMO, we’ve been working hard on localization into [b]7 languages[/b]. And Perun is our witness - this is only the beginning!

[b][h3]You can now play the demo in:[/h3][/b]
💗Russian
💗English
💗French
💗Italian
💗Spanish
💗Portuguese
💗German

And we’re not stopping there! What language do you think Humans are not that against Lizardwomen should speak next? Let us know in the comments ✍️

Thank you for being with us - your support is like a cup of warm mead on a cold night: comforting and invigorating! Stay tuned for more ❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/b5373bc907be48f0523f824b8a95971a9a9af497.png[/img]
